the operator directory did not survive its own gates, so nothing was published and the file already at live/ keeps its own read date. DraftRefusal: operators_2026.json is owner-verified (on 2026-09-15) and this drafter will not overwrite it — `force` no longer does either.
A re-draft of a 304'd source regenerates identical values and the only visible effect is that the sign-off vanishes.
A NEW EDITION writes a NEW FILE: pass the new edition year so the drafter writes curated/<stem>_<year>.json, and this one stays on disk as the evidence of what this app told people in its year.
To genuinely re-verify THIS edition, move the file aside by hand — that is a deliberate act with an author, which is the whole point.
